title: Beyond Targeted Delivery: The Emerging Immunomodulatory Landscape of Antibody-Oligonucleotide Conjugates.
snippet: Antibody-oligonucleotide conjugates (AOCs) are usually viewed as delivery vehicles that carry nucleic-acid payloads to defined cell populations for gene silencing or gene regulation.
